requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains syntactic ambiguities regarding ownership and phrase attachment. Controlled context clarifies that System-A is the orchestrator and owner of downstream systems and the Reporting flow. Ambiguities AMB-01 and AMB-02 are resolved using supported interpretations. The requirement is decomposed into two distinct functional requirements: one for adding a downstream system and one for enabling a subscription.

source_fragments: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A shall add System-B to its downstream systems.
structuring_notes: Resolved ambiguity AMB-01: 'their' refers to System-A. Action is autonomous by System-A.

source_fragments: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

fields.object: System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A shall allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
structuring_notes: Resolved ambiguity AMB-02: System-A owns the Reporting flow. Action is autonomous by System-A.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume specific subscription protocols or data formats.
